equation_summary: GRU. Per step s: f = sigmoid(h_{s-1} @ Wf + xf_s); r = sigmoid(h_{s-1} @ Wr + xr_s); z = tanh((h_{s-1} * r) @ W + x_s); h_s = f * h_{s-1} + (1 - f) * z. There is an explicit forget gate f and reset gate r with a fixed gate order (f,r computed from h_prev, then candidate z uses h_prev*r, then interpolation). All weights shared across steps. y_s = h_s. This is a closed NONLINEAR gated vector transition (sigmoid/tanh), not an affine scan.
gate_scope: data-dependent nonlinear gates (f=sigmoid forget, r=sigmoid reset), but applied via fixed shared weights
